A wellness retreat poster for "Ikigai Studio" featuring their autumn mindfulness workshop. The design centers on a single oversized ginkgo leaf rendered in warm charcoal brushstrokes against an off-white ground, with delicate hand-lettered Japanese characters flowing vertically down one side. Below the leaf, clean sans-serif typography announces "Autumn Equinox Retreat" and "September 23-25, 2024" in muted sage green.

The composition embraces generous negative space, allowing the leaf to breathe while maintaining perfect asymmetric balance. The illustration medium suggests traditional sumi-e painting with visible brush texture and organic ink spread, though executed with contemporary restraint. Color palette limited to charcoal black, warm sage green, and cream paper tone.

The mood is contemplative and grounding, appealing to urban professionals seeking authentic mindfulness experiences. Typography hierarchy remains minimal and unobtrusive, with venue details in the smallest scale at bottom margin. The overall aesthetic embodies Japanese principles of wabi-sabi through imperfect organic forms while maintaining Scandinavian clarity through abundant white space and functional layout.
